name: Latvia — Latvian parties
intro: compare it with Latvian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Latvia: those represented in the parliament (Saeima) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Saeima) after the 2022 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 100 members.

Prog.name: Progresīvie
Prog.priorities: Welfare state, Education, Defence and support for Ukraine
Prog.description: The Progressives, a social-democratic and socially liberal party in government since 2023.

Volt.name: Volt Latvija
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

JV.name: Jaunā Vienotība
JV.priorities: Defence and support for Ukraine, Deeper European integration, Fiscal discipline
JV.description: New Unity of Prime Minister Evika Siliņa, pro-European and focused on security.

ZZS.name: Zaļo un Zemnieku savienība
ZZS.priorities: Farmers and rural areas, Regions and rural services, Pensions and the elderly
ZZS.description: Union of Greens and Farmers, an agrarian centrist alliance and member of the governing coalition.

AS.name: Apvienotais saraksts
AS.priorities: Fiscal discipline, Regions and rural services, Security and law and order
AS.description: United List, a conservative alliance built around regional politicians.

NA.name: Nacionālā apvienība
NA.priorities: National language and culture, National identity, Defence and support for Ukraine
NA.description: National Alliance, a national-conservative party focused on Latvian language and identity.

Stabilitātei!.name: Stabilitātei!
Stabilitātei!.priorities: Cost of living, Rights of the national minority, Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries
Stabilitātei!.description: For Stability!, a populist party popular among Russian-speaking voters, critical of the government's economic policy.

LPV.name: Latvija pirmajā vietā
LPV.priorities: Traditional family values, Cost of living, National sovereignty
LPV.description: Latvia First, a right-wing populist party of businessman Ainārs Šlesers.
